name: Discount / Promo Field
summary: Native progressive discount-code disclosure that composes canonical Input and Button, plus an optional controlled list of target-confirmed applied codes.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native details disclosure containing code entry and confirmed-code composition.

anatomy.name: toggle
anatomy.description: Required non-empty native summary label and disclosure control.

anatomy.name: panel
anatomy.description: Disclosure content containing the required form and optional confirmed-code list.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Canonical Input composition that owns value, label, validation and associated feedback.

anatomy.name: apply
anatomy.description: Canonical Button submit action controlled by the target.

anatomy.name: appliedCodes
anatomy.description: Native list of zero or more target-confirmed codes.

anatomy.name: appliedCodeItem
anatomy.description: One confirmed code record and its target removal action.

anatomy.name: appliedCode
anatomy.description: Complete target-confirmed code string with direction isolation.

anatomy.name: remove
anatomy.description: Canonical per-code removal Button with contextual accessible name.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic size controlled by the parent container.

states.name: default
states.description: Closed native disclosure with no target request in progress.

states.name: open
states.description: The native details open state exposes the disclosure panel.

states.name: inputError
states.description: Target projects a rejected or inapplicable candidate through the canonical Input dependency state.

states.name: applyDisabled
states.description: Target projects application unavailability through the canonical Button disabled state and supplies a visible reason when needed.

states.name: applyBusy
states.description: Target projects pending work through the canonical Button busy and disabled states to prevent duplicate submission while preserving its label.

states.name: appliedCodes
states.description: One or more target-confirmed codes are present as native list items.

behavior.name: nativeDisclosure
behavior.description: Static Web owns native open/close after the initial open attribute; stateful adapters may control the live open property and toggle event.

behavior.name: inputComposition
behavior.description: Canonical Input is the sole label, value, validation, feedback, focus and native field owner.

behavior.name: nativeSubmit
behavior.description: One native form submit requests target validation/application; busy or disabled prevents duplicate activation.

behavior.name: controlledCodes
behavior.description: The target supplies zero or more confirmed records and preserves complete display strings without K4 normalization.

behavior.name: removeCode
behavior.description: Each removal action identifies its code and delegates replacement/persistence to the target.

behavior.name: targetState
behavior.description: Target owns normalization, allowed characters, stacking, applicability, requests, errors, warnings, totals, status, analytics, focus after removal and persistence; K4 is not a live region.

properties.name: toggleLabel
properties.description: Required non-empty localized native disclosure label.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Initial native open state in static Web or controlled live disclosure state in stateful adapters.

properties.name: input
properties.description: Required canonical Input composition with its complete field semantics.

properties.name: applyLabel
properties.description: Required non-empty visible canonical Button submit label.

properties.name: applyDisabled
properties.description: Projects target-owned application unavailability to canonical Button disabled behavior.

properties.name: applyBusy
properties.description: Projects target-owned application work to canonical Button busy and disabled behavior.

properties.name: appliedCodes
properties.description: Optional semantic native list of target-confirmed code records and contextual removal Buttons.

accessibility: Use native details and summary for progressive disclosure or preserve equivalent expanded state and keyboard behavior in a target adapter.
Compose a visible-label canonical Input and associate target rejection or applicability text with that field.
Preserve the entered candidate after recoverable failure and keep apply busy or disabled from activating twice.
Render confirmed codes as a native list and include the corresponding code in every removal action's accessible name.
Announce one contextual target result without making the Discount Field root, Input value or applied-code list a live region.

web.notes: Native details/form/list plus canonical Input and Button; target controls commerce truth and status.

shopify.notes: Dedicated Liquid maps localized composition to standard storefront discount actions; runtime/editor/live-store proof remains required.
